4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: I was walking down the corridor towards my office on the way back from lunch.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: Right next to the door, Lileas, Nia and Karl were waiting. They approached me.

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: Right next to the door, Lileas was waiting. She approached me.

12.speaker: Lileas Graf
12.text: “There has been an important update on the Koronti investigation.”

14.speaker: Lileas Graf
14.text: “An informant from HOS contacted us. He was identified as a low-level executive."

18.speaker: Karl Greiser
18.text: “We have interrogated him thoroughly and confirmed the information he gave us.”

20.speaker: Karl Greiser
20.text: “We now have proof that a subsidiary of HOS, Konrath Holdings, is a shell corporation engaged in money laundering for the Koranelli cartel."

21.speaker: Karl Greiser
21.text: “Over the past three years, approximately 15 million Sordish ren from the Koranellis' drug and weapons smuggling activities has gone through this corporation with Marcel Koronti's implicit approval."

22.speaker: Player
22.text: “This can't be. This must be a ploy against HOS or Koronti.”

23.speaker: Nia Morgna
23.text: “Whatever you say, there is now enough evidence.”

25.speaker: Nia Morgna
25.text: “Why are you so willing to protect HOS? Why is it so hard to believe?”

26.speaker: Narrator
26.text: All eyes in the room turned to me.

27.speaker: Player
27.text: “That settles it then. What is the plan?”

28.speaker: Nia Morgna
28.text: “The time has come. Frankly, we have been preparing for this possibility.”

29.speaker: Nia Morgna
29.text: “Please follow us to the comms room.”

30.speaker: Narrator
30.text: Nia gestured towards the door and I followed the two women down the hall.

31.speaker: Player
31.text: “Nothing. It's just hard to believe such a respectable business would stoop to this level.”

32.speaker: Nia Morgna
32.text: “That is why none of these oligarchs can be trusted. They would do anything for money.”

34.speaker: Nia Morgna
34.text: “Regardless of your uncertainty, we will move.”

35.speaker: Narrator
35.text: We descended the spiral staircase at the very edge of the palace, close to where my office was located.

36.speaker: Narrator
36.text: Going through narrower corridors than upstairs, we came in front of a large door with a shield and a goat carved on it.

37.speaker: Narrator
37.text: Nia opened the door and we entered. After taking our seats, she gave me a sheepish look.

38.speaker: Nia Morgna
38.text: “Mr. President. I said we have been preparing for this opportunity, but that might've been an understatement.”

39.speaker: Nia Morgna
39.text: "Our attack teams are ready to go. They've surrounded Mr. Koronti's villa in Estord.”

40.speaker: Narrator
40.text: She nodded at Karl. Karl leaned forward and spoke into the microphone.

42.speaker: Narrator
42.text: We sat there for a few minutes, waiting anxiously. Finally, Karl received a radio transmission.

45.speaker: Player
45.text: “I hope we caught the right person.”

47.speaker: Lileas Graf
47.text: “Now that he's been arrested, Sordland will have one less traitor. We will learn the truth from him directly.”

49.speaker: Lileas Graf
49.text: “All of his contacts, everyone he has been dealing with.”

50.speaker: Lileas Graf
50.text: “Of course, and our administration will successfully handle it. I am sure.”

51.speaker: Nia Morgna
51.text: “I want to especially confirm the rumour about his contact in the administration. We will squeeze every single drop of information we can out from him.”

53.speaker: Player
53.text: “I am looking forward to the results.”

55.speaker: Lileas Graf
55.text: “We will bring them to you as quickly as possible.”

57.speaker: Nia Morgna
57.text: “The news ought to break any moment now.”

58.speaker: Lileas Graf
58.text: “This was all for today, Mr. President. We will keep you posted.”

61.speaker: Narrator
61.text: They left one by one and I made my way back to my office.

65.speaker: Narrator
65.text: This could be the end of my presidency. If Marcel talked, everything could end.

66.speaker: Narrator
66.text: There must be a way out of this.

67.speaker: Narrator
67.text: Sordland now felt a little bit safer now that Marcel had been taken care of.

69.speaker: Lileas Graf
69.text: “There has been an update on the Koronti investigation.”

71.speaker: Lileas Graf
71.text: “Unfortunately we were not able to find any leads.”

72.speaker: Lileas Graf
72.text: “At this time, we will not be able to continue the investigation.”

73.speaker: Lileas Graf
73.text: “No matter how much we probed into HOS, no matter how many employees we tried to get insider information from, their mouths were completely shut.”

74.speaker: Player
74.text: “Everyone is innocent until proven guilty, right?”

77.speaker: Lileas Graf
77.text: “There are many words that describe HOS and Koronti and I still believe innocent is not one of them.”

78.speaker: Lileas Graf
78.text: “Regardless, that doesn't change the fact that we are currently stuck.”

79.speaker: Lileas Graf
79.text: “No need to exaggerate. We will find something in the future. I am sure.”

81.speaker: Lileas Graf
81.text: “I just wanted to let you know that I will keep my eyes open. I will make sure the truth comes out about HOS.”

82.speaker: Player
82.text: “Make sure you don't let emotions affect your judgement.”

84.speaker: Player
84.text: “In time, I am sure it will.”

87.speaker: Lileas Graf
87.text: “We were so close to getting him."

88.speaker: Lileas Graf
88.text: “Anyway. I won't take up more of your time.”

90.speaker: Narrator
90.text: As soon as she turned her back to leave, I couldn't help but smirk.
